answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The gale edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 89 clones produces a signature the oasis analysis flags immediately. A hostile operator must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the garden settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
